messages.text: For a Automotive use case involving automotive radar, where would Oscilloscope fit in the test workflow?

For automotive radar, the knowledge base places the workflow around an automotive radar echo generator: the R&S AREG800A is for automotive radar echo generation, not an RF signal generator or spectrum analyzer [4].
Its supported test role is dynamic artificial object generation, using hybrid analog stepped delay lines for short distances under 17 m and digital implementation out to 3000 m, or a digital FMCW-radar mode with maximum generated distance of 3000 m [5].
